notes.title: NEXT FEST FEEDBACK
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Dilemma Enthusiasts,[/h2][p][/p][p]Next Fest has just finished and we are evaluating all the feedback received. Some of the things you've commented on and asked for we already had planned and few others came quite handy, [b]thank you for that![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Another important topic, we were planning on launch the game with 10% discount, but you guys surprised us by doubling our Wishlists goal, [b]so we are also doubling our launch discount, it will be 20%[/b]. Now [u]if we reach 100k Wishlists, we will go with 30% launch[/u] discount (we aren't that far, we believe that with your continuous support, we can get there easily).[/p][p][/p][p]Now Dan is baking some more thought-provoking dilemmas and ASAP we'll announce the release date.  [/p][p][/p][p]And finally, about the Demo, you will be able to play it until the end of this month, after that we will be removing the Demo from the store, we planned to keep the Demo only during the Next Fest, but since we felt that some people still want to try it, we decided to leave it there for more few days.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Thanks again for your support, feel free to spread the word about The Trolley Solution!
Sincerely,
Peterson Bueno (another fan of Dan's work)[/i][/p]
